messages.text: Great - there is a review question on #75 - can you please answer this, and if actions are needed propose them ?
I’ll read the review question on #75, check it against the current layout evidence, and reply on the PR with any proposed follow-up actions.

The gap comes from the selected service routes. The LAr budget uses 80–100 mm cryogenic jackets and an assumed S-bend before the endcap. Si-W carries its backbone outside the endcap and turns outward through the 400 mm rear HCAL gap; its 30 mm front seam is installation space.

The LAr bend calculation also uses the N2 pipe’s starting radius for the larger LAr utility lines, whose actual feedthrough positions are undefined. I’ll make that limitation clear and propose a route study before changing the gap.
